name: Rise of the Silithid
summary: In Orgrimmar, you carry Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser's report on the insect threat to Zilzibin Drumlore.

sections.title: Someone Who Knows
sections.body: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser wants the report in the hands of someone who understands such matters. Zilzibin Drumlore is a troll scholar and historian who has spent much time studying Azeroth's unique life forms. Fizzledowser hopes Zilzibin can learn what the danger is and how it might be stopped. All the help they can get will be needed. Zilzibin lives in a house on the Drag's second tier, in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Zilzibin's Answer
sections.body: Zilzibin Drumlore has faced these creatures before. He believes Fizzledowser chose well in sending the report, and you with it. They will devour the Tanaris desert swiftly and rank among the greatest menaces anyone will face. They are the silithid, tools of one of the gravest threats to both Horde and Alliance. Zilzibin grieves that no one saw the danger sooner.

faq.answer: Zilzibin Drumlore is a troll scholar and historian who has spent much time studying the life forms unique to Azeroth's ecology.

aliases: who gives rise of the silithid
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser gives you the report and asks you to carry it to Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where is Zilzibin Drumlore located in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Zilzibin Drumlore lives in a house on the Drag's second tier, in Orgrimmar.
